newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Danone to finalise stake in Israeli firm.
newsitem.headline: Danone to finalise stake in Israeli firm.

text.p: French food giant Danone Group will shortly sign a contract to finalise its purchase of a 20 percent stake in Israel food firm, Nahariya Dairies Strauss Ltd, Danone chairman and chief executive officer said on Tuesday.
"We intend to sign that (the contract) next week in Israel," Franck Riboud told Reuters at a news conference. He later said the process of closing the deal could last till early January.

In May, Danone signed a Memorandum of Understanding to buy a stake in privately-owned Nahariya, one of Israel's largest food manufacturers. Under the terms of the agreement, Danone will supply know-how to the Israeli firm.
"We have returned to Israel because we have a good relationship with the Strauss family and will continue to give them technical assistance," Riboud said.
